Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openscriptures/morphhb/3d15126fb1ef74867fc1434be1942e837932691f/wlc/Gen.xml · Gen.7.2

### Current best selected translation

#### claude-sonnet-5-5

Final opinion (Korean original): '암수 일곱 쌍'으로 잠정 정리한다.

#### gemini-3.8-flash-medium

#### gpt-6.1-sol

Final opinion (Korean original): 반복수사 שבעה שבעה의 분배형태와 사람용어인 איש ואשתו의동물짝 적용을 드러낸다.한국어 일곱씩은 반복수사의분배기능을 자연스럽게옮긴다.뒤의둘은 수컷과짝을 이룬다.정결하지않은이라는부정을지켜 부정형범주를동일어휘로유지한다. 반론: 정결한동물은 일곱쌍(14마리)인지 총일곱인지 논쟁이있다.수컷과그짝의분배를일곱에적용하면 일곱쌍이자연스러우나 반복수사만으로 숫자를곱하지는않는다.직역후보는 현대독자에게 수량을불명확하게할수있다.정결은 위생이나후대음식법 전체를뜻한다고확정못한다.בהמה범위를가축만으로 제한할지도유보. 고정WLC와Swete차이를구별하고인간전문가검수대기.

Final opinion (Korean original): 본 견해는 독립 평가이며 최종 확정 채택이 아닙니다. 폭우/일반비의 작위적 이분법을 배제하고, 40주야의 강우 지속성을 왜곡 없이 기술한 WLC 기반 잠정안을 권고합니다. 홍수 전체 기간과의 혼동이나 전 지구적 범위에 대한 교리적 확장은 추가하지 않습니다.

#### gpt-6.1-sol

The rain was upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.

Final opinion (Korean original): 두 사십과 비의 지속을 유지. 원인·전지구성·홍수 전체 종료시점은 덧붙이지 않는다. 실제 사본·그리스어 관찰과 비교해도 고정WLC 잠정선택 유지. 최초원문 인증·인간전문가 검수완료 아님.

Counterargument (Korean): גשם이 언제나 מטר와 배타적인 폭우 대립이라는 Gemini 초기 설명은 근거 미확인으로 채택하지 않음. 홍수전체기간과 강우기간을 혼동하지 않음.

## Notes

Verse 1 preserves I have seen, righteous, before me and this generation, while including the whole household. Verse 2 retains distributive seven by seven with a male and its mate. Seven pairs (fourteen animals) is a strong reading when the pair is distributed, but seven in total remains an alternative; the wording does not fix a total. Repeated sevens and male/female in the Greek edition do not settle the question. Cleanliness criteria, later sacrifice and harmonization with chapter 6 are not inserted.

Input is pinned WLC4.20/OSHB. Swete1901 p.10 is a modern scholarly edition of an ancient version. Leningrad4v was inspected for limited consonantal phrases only, not every vowel, accent or Masoretic note. Modern apparatus and full witness collation remain pending.

WLC verse 3 does not explicitly distinguish clean from unclean birds. The inspected Swete1901 edition does: clean birds by sevens, unclean birds by twos. Whether this longer Greek reflects another Hebrew Vorlage or harmonizing expansion remains unresolved. WLC remains provisional. Seven pairs is a strong reading, but a total of seven remains an alternative; distributive sevens are retained and seed is rendered as offspring.

Verse 4 distinguishes seven more days and forty days and forty nights. Every living thing interprets yequm contextually; everything that exists is a broader alternative. Verse 5 does not establish immediacy, inner motives or absolute sinlessness. Verse 6 retains age six hundred and floodwaters upon the earth. Swete main text lacks a water noun here; an addition appears in its apparatus, but its manuscript attribution is unverified. Because of in verse 7 has a fleeing-from alternative; no entry date, water level, headcount or geological extent is supplied.

For verses 3–7, Swete1901 pp.10–11 were directly read and limited consonantal phrases inspected in a Leningrad4v photograph. Full manuscripts, vowels, accents, Masoretic notes and modern apparatus or other Hebrew witnesses remain uncollated. Pinned WLC is an electronic transcription, not proof of the earliest wording or independent witness consensus.

Verses 8–9 retain the connected list and movement two by two. Swete1901 p.11 has a longer distinction between clean and unclean birds, absent in pinned WLC. Its Hebrew background and origin remain unresolved; WLC is retained provisionally. Two by two does not fix the total at two or harmonize it with sevens.

In verse 11 pinned WLC and the inspected consonantal wording of Leningrad4v have day seventeen of the second month. Swete1901 p.11 reads twenty-seven and lacks a main-text equivalent for great in great deep. These differences are preserved; without established grounds to replace the Hebrew input, seventeen and great deep remain provisional. This does not prove their priority. No calendar conversion, full flood duration or geological mechanism is added.

Verse 10 marks the seven days and the state of floodwaters; verse 12 describes rain for forty days and forty nights. A fixed intensity contrast between geshem and matar was not established, so rain is retained. Inspection was limited to Swete and consonantal phrases in Leningrad. Modern apparatus, other Hebrew witnesses including Samaritan texts and 4Q252, other ancient versions and specialist review remain pending.
